title: Freedom, The Label
category: Brand Strategy · Social Media · Creative Direction
intro: A fashion brand launch concept built from strategy to execution, exploring how a new label could build identity, community and visibility across digital channels.

sections.heading: THE BRIEF
sections.text: How do you launch a fashion label from zero and turn it into a recognisable digital brand?

sections.heading: THE APPROACH
sections.text: From brand positioning and audience definition to channel strategy, content planning and launch execution, the concept was developed as a complete brand journey rather than a collection of isolated assets.

sections.heading: FROM STRATEGY TO EXECUTION
sections.text: The strategy was translated into a multi-channel content ecosystem across Instagram, Pinterest and LinkedIn, with each platform playing a different role in building awareness, identity and community.
